retrieved.heading: Item condition
retrieved.text:
A returned item must be unused, unwashed, and in resalable condition. Original tags, accessories, and packaging must be included when they were supplied with the item.

Trying an item indoors for fit does not by itself make it ineligible. Visible wear, odors, stains, alterations, or missing components may cause the return to be rejected.

retrieved.heading: Canadian returns
retrieved.text:
Aster & Row does not provide prepaid labels for ordinary Canadian change-of-mind returns. The customer is responsible for return postage. When Aster & Row confirms that an item arrived damaged or incorrect, support will provide an appropriate resolution without charging an ordinary return fee.

Direct exchanges are not offered for Canadian orders. An eligible customer may return the item and place a new order.

retrieved.heading: Return window
retrieved.text:
A customer whose TrailPlus membership was active when an order was placed receives a **45-calendar-day return window from delivery** for eligible items.

Joining TrailPlus after placing an order does not extend that order’s return window.

Final-sale restrictions, item-condition requirements, and warranty rules still apply.

retrieved.heading: Standard return window
retrieved.text:
Customers on the standard plan may request a return within **30 calendar days of delivery**.

TrailPlus members receive a different return window. See the TrailPlus Membership Policy. The membership must have been active when the order was placed.

retrieved.heading: Item condition
retrieved.text:
A returned item must be unused, unwashed, and in resalable condition. Original tags, accessories, and packaging must be included when they were supplied with the item.

Trying an item indoors for fit does not by itself make it ineligible. Visible wear, odors, stains, alterations, or missing components may cause the return to be rejected.

retrieved.heading: Standard return window
retrieved.text:
Customers on the standard plan may request a return within **30 calendar days of delivery**.

TrailPlus members receive a different return window. See the TrailPlus Membership Policy. The membership must have been active when the order was placed.

retrieved.heading: Canadian returns
retrieved.text:
Aster & Row does not provide prepaid labels for ordinary Canadian change-of-mind returns. The customer is responsible for return postage. When Aster & Row confirms that an item arrived damaged or incorrect, support will provide an appropriate resolution without charging an ordinary return fee.

Direct exchanges are not offered for Canadian orders. An eligible customer may return the item and place a new order.

retrieved.heading: Membership verification

user_message: A final-sale bag arrived with a broken zipper yesterday. Am I completely out of luck?

retrieved.heading: Final-sale items
retrieved.text: Final-sale items are still eligible for review when they arrive damaged, defective, or incorrect. Final sale only prevents change-of-mind returns.

retrieved.heading: Damaged or incorrect items
retrieved.text: The final-sale restriction does not remove a customer’s right to report an item that arrived damaged, defective, or different from what was ordered. Those cases follow the Damaged or Wrong Items Policy.

retrieved.heading: Exclusions and exceptions
retrieved.text:
Final-sale items and gift cards are not returnable for a change of mind. Damaged or incorrect final-sale items may still qualify for assistance under the Damaged or Wrong Items Policy.

Warranty claims are handled separately from ordinary returns.

retrieved.heading: What counts as final sale
retrieved.text:
An item is final sale only when the product page, cart, or order confirmation clearly labels it **FINAL SALE**. A discount or promotional code does not automatically make an item final sale.

Gift cards are always final sale.

final_response:
I’m sorry to hear the zipper arrived broken. Even though the bag was marked **FINAL SALE**, our policy still allows you to get help when a final‑sale item arrives damaged, defective, or incorrect. The “final‑sale” label only blocks change‑of‑mind returns; it does **not** prevent us from reviewing a damaged product and providing a replacement or refund under our Damaged or Wrong Items process【04-damaged-or-wrong-items.md — Final-sale items】.  

To move forward, please open a “Damaged or Wrong Item” request in your account or contact our support team with your order number and a photo of the broken zipper. They’ll verify the issue and arrange the appropriate resolution for you.

If you need any help starting the claim, just let me know!

Canadian orders are supported. They’re processed in 1–2 business days before dispatch, and typically arrive within 5–9 business days after that point. Customs or carrier delays can extend the estimate (06‑international‑shipping.md — Canada delivery estimate; 06‑international‑shipping.md — Duties and taxes).  

If you’re ordering from Canada, you should expect delivery within that 5–9‑business‑day window after your order ships.

retrieved.heading: Shipping benefit
retrieved.text:
TrailPlus members receive free standard shipping on eligible United States orders without a minimum purchase amount.

The benefit does not cover expedited shipping, import duties, Canadian return postage, or other international charges.

retrieved.heading: Membership verification
retrieved.text: When membership status is not available to the agent, it should explain the standard policy and ask the customer to confirm whether TrailPlus was active on the order date. It must not assume membership based only on the customer requesting the benefit.

retrieved.heading: Processing time
retrieved.text: Most orders require **1–2 business days** for processing before they are dispatched. Business days exclude weekends and United States federal holidays.

retrieved.heading: Delivery estimates after dispatch
retrieved.text:
- Contiguous United States: **3–5 business days**.
- Alaska and Hawaii: **5–8 business days**.
- PO boxes: **5–9 business days**.

These are estimates rather than guaranteed delivery dates.

retrieved.heading: Shipping charges
retrieved.text:
Standard shipping is free for eligible United States orders of **$75 or more after discounts and before tax**. TrailPlus members receive free standard domestic shipping without a minimum order value.

Expedited shipping charges are shown at checkout and are not refundable unless Aster & Row shipped the wrong item or the shipment was damaged in transit.

retrieved.heading: Delivery problems
retrieved.text: A shipment marked delivered but not received should be reported to support. The agent may explain the policy but must not claim that a carrier investigation has been opened unless the application actually supports that action.

retrieved.heading: Standard return window
retrieved.text:
Customers on the standard plan may request a return within **30 calendar days of delivery**.

TrailPlus members receive a different return window. See the TrailPlus Membership Policy. The membership must have been active when the order was placed.

retrieved.heading: Item condition
retrieved.text:
A returned item must be unused, unwashed, and in resalable condition. Original tags, accessories, and packaging must be included when they were supplied with the item.

Trying an item indoors for fit does not by itself make it ineligible. Visible wear, odors, stains, alterations, or missing components may cause the return to be rejected.

retrieved.heading: Return shipping and refunds
retrieved.text:
A **$6.95 return shipping fee** is deducted from the refund for standard domestic returns. The fee is waived when Aster & Row sent the wrong item or the item arrived damaged.

Refunds are issued to the original payment method after the return is inspected. Customers should allow **5–7 business days after inspection** for the refund to appear.

Original outbound shipping charges are not refundable unless the order was incorrect or damaged on arrival.

retrieved.heading: Exclusions and exceptions
retrieved.text:
Final-sale items and gift cards are not returnable for a change of mind. Damaged or incorrect final-sale items may still qualify for assistance under the Damaged or Wrong Items Policy.

Warranty claims are handled separately from ordinary returns.

retrieved.heading: Duties and taxes

retrieved.heading: Canadian returns
retrieved.text:
Aster & Row does not provide prepaid labels for ordinary Canadian change-of-mind returns. The customer is responsible for return postage. When Aster & Row confirms that an item arrived damaged or incorrect, support will provide an appropriate resolution without charging an ordinary return fee.

Direct exchanges are not offered for Canadian orders. An eligible customer may return the item and place a new order.

retrieved.heading: Reporting window
retrieved.text:
Customers should report an item that arrived damaged, visibly defective, or different from what was ordered within **7 calendar days of delivery**.

The customer should provide the order ID, a short description, and clear photographs of the item and packaging when reasonably possible.

retrieved.heading: Available resolutions
retrieved.text:
After review, Aster & Row may offer a replacement, refund, or another appropriate resolution. Availability of a replacement depends on stock.

A return shipping fee is not charged when Aster & Row confirms that the item arrived damaged or that the wrong item was sent.

retrieved.heading: Final-sale items
retrieved.text: Final-sale items are still eligible for review when they arrive damaged, defective, or incorrect. Final sale only prevents change-of-mind returns.

retrieved.heading: Reports after seven days
retrieved.text:
A manufacturing defect reported after the seven-day arrival window may be considered under the Warranty Policy. Normal wear, accidental damage, and misuse are not arrival defects.

The support agent must not promise that a refund or replacement has been approved before a human review is completed.

retrieved.heading: Cancellation window
retrieved.text:
A customer may request cancellation within **30 minutes of placing an order**, but only while the order status is `pending`.

A cancellation cannot be guaranteed. Once the status changes to `processing`, `shipped`, `delivered`, or another later state, the order cannot be cancelled through the normal cancellation process.

retrieved.heading: Address changes
retrieved.text:
An address correction may be requested within 30 minutes while an order is still pending. A human support specialist must complete the change.

After an order enters processing, Aster & Row cannot guarantee an address change. After shipment, the customer may contact the carrier, but carrier changes are outside Aster & Row’s control.

retrieved.heading: Product or quantity changes
retrieved.text: Items and quantities cannot be edited after checkout. When cancellation is still possible, the customer may request cancellation and place a new order.

retrieved.heading: Agent limitations
retrieved.text: The support agent may check the current order status and explain the policy. It must not claim that an order was cancelled or changed unless a supported action confirms completion.

Our return policy varies a bit depending on whether you’re a regular customer or a TrailPlus member, but the core rules are the same:

**Return window**  
• Standard customers: you may request a return within **30 calendar days of delivery** (01‑returns‑policy‑current.md — Standard return window).  
• TrailPlus members: if the membership was active at the time the order was placed, you have a **45‑calendar‑day return window from delivery** (09‑trailplus‑membership.md — Return window).

**Condition of returned items**  
Returned items must be unused, unwashed, and in resalable condition. All original tags, accessories, and packaging must be included (01‑returns‑policy‑current.md — Item condition). If an item shows visible wear, odors, stains, or missing components, the return may be rejected (01‑returns‑policy‑current.md — Item condition).

**Return shipping fee**  
A flat **$6.95 return shipping fee** is deducted from the refund for standard domestic returns (01‑returns‑policy‑current.md — Return shipping and refunds). That fee is waived if we sent the wrong item or the item arrived damaged (01‑returns‑policy‑current.md — Return shipping and refunds).

**Refund timeline**  
After the return is inspected, refunds are issued to the original payment method and typically take **5–7 business days** to appear (01‑returns‑policy‑current.md — Return shipping and refunds).

**What can’t be returned**  
• Items that are marked **FINAL SALE** or **gift cards** are not returnable for a change of mind (03‑final‑sale‑and‑promotions.md — What counts as final sale).  
• Final‑sale items that are damaged or incorrect still qualify for assistance under the Damaged or Wrong Items Policy (03‑final‑sale‑and‑promotions.md — Damaged or incorrect items).  
• Warranty claims are handled separately from ordinary returns (03‑final‑sale‑and‑promotions.md — Damaged or incorrect items).

**Additional notes**  
• If you receive the wrong or a damaged item, we’ll cover the return cost and provide a replacement or refund (01‑returns‑policy‑current.md — Return shipping and refunds).  
• For international (Canadian) orders, return postage is the customer’s responsibility unless the item is damaged or incorrect (06‑international‑shipping.md — Canadian returns).

Let me know if you need help starting a return or if you have a specific order in mind!

**Key points for TrailPlus members**

- **Return window:** 45 days from delivery, but only if the membership was active when the order was placed. Joining after the order does not extend the window (09‑trailplus‑membership.md).  
- **Item condition & fees:** The same conditions apply as for standard customers: unused, unwashed, resalable items with original tags, accessories, and packaging. The $6.95 return‑shipping fee still applies unless we shipped the wrong item or it arrived damaged (01‑returns‑policy‑current.md).  
- **Refund timeline:** Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days after inspection (01‑returns‑policy‑current.md).

| Aspect | Details |

| **Exclusions** | Final‑sale items and gift cards cannot be returned for a change of mind. Damaged or incorrect final‑sale items may still qualify for assistance under our Damaged or Wrong Items policy. |
| **International (Canadian) orders** | We do not provide prepaid return labels for ordinary change‑of‑mind returns. The customer is responsible for return postage, but the return‑fee waiver still applies if the item was wrong or damaged. (See Canadian returns policy.) |

- You may return an item within **30 calendar days of delivery**. (01-returns-policy-current.md — Standard return window)

An item is final sale only when the product page, cart, or order confirmation clearly labels it **FINAL SALE**. A discount or promotional code does not automatically make an item final sale.

Gift cards are always final sale.

retrieved.heading: Change-of-mind returns
retrieved.text: Final-sale items cannot be returned or exchanged because of fit, color preference, duplicate purchase, or another change of mind.

retrieved.heading: Damaged or incorrect items
retrieved.text: The final-sale restriction does not remove a customer’s right to report an item that arrived damaged, defective, or different from what was ordered. Those cases follow the Damaged or Wrong Items Policy.

retrieved.heading: Bundles
retrieved.text: A promotional bundle must be returned as a complete bundle unless a component arrived damaged or incorrect. A missing component may reduce or prevent the refund.

retrieved.heading: Processing time
retrieved.text: Most orders require **1–2 business days** for processing before they are dispatched. Business days exclude weekends and United States federal holidays.

retrieved.heading: Delivery estimates after dispatch
retrieved.text:
- Contiguous United States: **3–5 business days**.
- Alaska and Hawaii: **5–8 business days**.
- PO boxes: **5–9 business days**.

These are estimates rather than guaranteed delivery dates.

retrieved.heading: Shipping charges
retrieved.text:
Standard shipping is free for eligible United States orders of **$75 or more after discounts and before tax**. TrailPlus members receive free standard domestic shipping without a minimum order value.

Expedited shipping charges are shown at checkout and are not refundable unless Aster & Row shipped the wrong item or the shipment was damaged in transit.

retrieved.heading: Delivery problems
retrieved.text: A shipment marked delivered but not received should be reported to support. The agent may explain the policy but must not claim that a carrier investigation has been opened unless the application actually supports that action.

final_response:
Our return policy is broken down by the type of plan you’re on and the condition of the item you’re sending back:

1. **Standard plan** – You may request a return within **30 calendar days of delivery**.  
2. **TrailPlus members** – If your TrailPlus membership was active at the time the order was placed, you receive a longer **45‑calendar‑day return window from delivery**.  
3. **Returned items** – Must be unused, unwashed, and in resalable condition.  Original tags, accessories, and packaging must be included.  Items that show visible wear, odors, stains, or missing components may be rejected.  
4. **Return shipping fee** – A flat **$6.95 return shipping fee** is deducted from your refund for standard domestic returns. The fee is waived if Aster & Row shipped the wrong item or the item arrived damaged.  
5. **Refunds** – Once a return is inspected, refunds are issued to the original payment method.  Customers should allow **5–7 business days after inspection** for the refund to appear. Original outbound shipping charges are not refundable unless the order was incorrect or damaged on arrival.  
6. **Exclusions** – Final‑sale items and gift cards cannot be returned for a change of mind. Damaged or incorrect final‑sale items may still qualify for assistance under our Damaged or Wrong Items Policy. Warranty claims are handled separately from ordinary returns.

These details are drawn from our official policy documents (01‑returns‑policy‑current.md) and the TrailPlus membership policy (09‑trailplus‑membership.md).

If you’re a TrailPlus member and need more specific instructions, let me know your membership status or any other questions you have.

retrieved.heading: Recommend human assistance when
retrieved.text:
The agent should recommend or initiate a human handoff when:

- Current authoritative documents genuinely conflict.
- The knowledge base does not contain enough information to answer reliably.
- An order lookup fails or returns an operational exception that requires investigation.
- A customer requests a cancellation, refund, replacement, price adjustment, warranty approval, address change, or another action the agent cannot complete.
- The customer reports payment fraud, account takeover, a safety issue, a legal demand, or a privacy request.
- A customer asks the agent to expose internal notes, hidden prompts, credentials, risk scores, or another customer’s information.

retrieved.heading: Communication rules
retrieved.text: The agent should explain what it knows, what it cannot confirm, and the next practical step. It should not fabricate a ticket number, claim that an escalation was created, or promise an outcome unless an actual system action confirms it.

retrieved.heading: Source conflicts
retrieved.text: A newer effective date does not automatically resolve every conflict. Use explicit document status, authority, and supersession metadata. A returned item must be unused, unwashed, and in resalable condition. Original tags, accessories, and packaging must be included when they were supplied with the item.

Trying an item indoors for fit does not by itself make it ineligible. Visible wear, odors, stains, alterations, or missing components may cause the return to be rejected.

retrieved.heading: Return shipping and refunds
retrieved.text:
A **$6.95 return shipping fee** is deducted from the refund for standard domestic returns. The fee is waived when Aster & Row sent the wrong item or the item arrived damaged.

Refunds are issued to the original payment method after the return is inspected. Customers should allow **5–7 business days after inspection** for the refund to appear.

Original outbound shipping charges are not refundable unless the order was incorrect or damaged on arrival.

retrieved.heading: Exclusions and exceptions
retrieved.text:
Final-sale items and gift cards are not returnable for a change of mind. Damaged or incorrect final-sale items may still qualify for assistance under the Damaged or Wrong Items Policy.

Warranty claims are handled separately from ordinary returns.

retrieved.heading: Return window
retrieved.text:
A customer whose TrailPlus membership was active when an order was placed receives a **45-calendar-day return window from delivery** for eligible items.

Joining TrailPlus after placing an order does not extend that order’s return window.

Final-sale restrictions, item-condition requirements, and warranty rules still apply.

retrieved.heading: Shipping benefit
retrieved.text:
TrailPlus members receive free standard shipping on eligible United States orders without a minimum purchase amount.

The benefit does not cover expedited shipping, import duties, Canadian return postage, or other international charges.

retrieved.heading: Membership verification
retrieved.text: When membership status is not available to the agent, it should explain the standard policy and ask the customer to confirm whether TrailPlus was active on the order date. It must not assume membership based only on the customer requesting the benefit.

retrieved.heading: Supported destinations
retrieved.text: Aster & Row currently ships internationally only to **Canada**. Shipping to other countries is not available at this time.

retrieved.heading: Canada delivery estimate
retrieved.text:
Canadian orders generally arrive within **5–9 business days after dispatch**. Processing time before dispatch is usually 1–2 business days.

Delivery estimates may be extended by customs processing or carrier delays.

retrieved.heading: Duties and taxes
retrieved.text: Import duties, taxes, and brokerage charges are not prepaid by Aster & Row. The recipient is responsible for charges assessed by Canadian authorities or the carrier.

retrieved.heading: Canadian returns
retrieved.text:
Aster & Row does not provide prepaid labels for ordinary Canadian change-of-mind returns. The customer is responsible for return postage. When Aster & Row confirms that an item arrived damaged or incorrect, support will provide an appropriate resolution without charging an ordinary return fee.

Direct exchanges are not offered for Canadian orders. An eligible customer may return the item and place a new order.

retrieved.heading: Cancellation window
retrieved.text:
A customer may request cancellation within **30 minutes of placing an order**, but only while the order status is `pending`.

A cancellation cannot be guaranteed. Once the status changes to `processing`, `shipped`, `delivered`, or another later state, the order cannot be cancelled through the normal cancellation process.

retrieved.heading: Address changes
retrieved.text:
An address correction may be requested within 30 minutes while an order is still pending. A human support specialist must complete the change.

After an order enters processing, Aster & Row cannot guarantee an address change. After shipment, the customer may contact the carrier, but carrier changes are outside Aster & Row’s control.

retrieved.heading: Product or quantity changes
retrieved.text: Items and quantities cannot be edited after checkout. When cancellation is still possible, the customer may request cancellation and place a new order.

retrieved.heading: Agent limitations
retrieved.text: The support agent may check the current order status and explain the policy. It must not claim that an order was cancelled or changed unless a supported action confirms completion.

retrieved.heading: What counts as final sale
retrieved.text:
An item is final sale only when the product page, cart, or order confirmation clearly labels it **FINAL SALE**. A discount or promotional code does not automatically make an item final sale.

Gift cards are always final sale.

retrieved.heading: Change-of-mind returns
retrieved.text: Final-sale items cannot be returned or exchanged because of fit, color preference, duplicate purchase, or another change of mind.

retrieved.heading: Damaged or incorrect items
retrieved.text: The final-sale restriction does not remove a customer’s right to report an item that arrived damaged, defective, or different from what was ordered. Those cases follow the Damaged or Wrong Items Policy.

retrieved.heading: Bundles
retrieved.text: A promotional bundle must be returned as a complete bundle unless a component arrived damaged or incorrect. A missing component may reduce or prevent the refund.

retrieved.heading: Processing time
retrieved.text: Most orders require **1–2 business days** for processing before they are dispatched. Business days exclude weekends and United States federal holidays.

retrieved.heading: Delivery estimates after dispatch
retrieved.text:
- Contiguous United States: **3–5 business days**.
- Alaska and Hawaii: **5–8 business days**.
- PO boxes: **5–9 business days**.

These are estimates rather than guaranteed delivery dates.

retrieved.heading: Shipping charges
retrieved.text:
Standard shipping is free for eligible United States orders of **$75 or more after discounts and before tax**. TrailPlus members receive free standard domestic shipping without a minimum order value.

Expedited shipping charges are shown at checkout and are not refundable unless Aster & Row shipped the wrong item or the shipment was damaged in transit.

retrieved.heading: Delivery problems
retrieved.text: A shipment marked delivered but not received should be reported to support. The agent may explain the policy but must not claim that a carrier investigation has been opened unless the application actually supports that action.

final_response:
Our return policy is designed to make returns straightforward while protecting both parties.  
**Standard return window**  
- You can request a return within **30 calendar days of delivery**. (01‑returns-policy-current.md — Standard return window)  

**TrailPlus members**  
- If your TrailPlus membership was active at the time the order was placed, you have a **45‑calendar‑day return window** from delivery. (09‑trailplus‑membership.md — Return window)  

**What qualifies for a return**  
- The item must be **unused, unwashed, and in resalable condition**. Original tags, accessories, and packaging should be included. (01‑returns-policy-current.md — Item condition)  
- If the item arrived damaged or you received the wrong item, the return fee is waived and you can still file a return. (01‑returns-policy-current.md — Return shipping and refunds)  

**Return shipping fee**  
- A $6.95 return shipping fee is deducted from the refund for standard domestic returns. (01‑returns-policy-current.md — Return shipping and refunds)  
- For Canadian orders, we do not provide prepaid return labels for ordinary change‑of‑mind returns; the customer pays return postage unless the item was wrong or damaged. (06‑international‑shipping.md — Canadian returns)  

**Refund timeline**  
- After we receive and inspect the returned item, refunds are issued to the original payment method within **5–7 business days**. (01‑returns-policy-current.md — Return shipping and refunds)  

**Exclusions**  
- Final‑sale items and gift cards cannot be returned for a change of mind. (03‑final‑sale‑and‑promotions.md — What counts as final sale)  
- However, damaged or incorrect final‑sale items may still qualify under our Damaged or Wrong Items Policy. (01‑returns-policy-current.md — Exclusions and exceptions)  

If you need help initiating a return or have questions about a specific order, let me know and I can guide you through the next steps.

A customer may request cancellation within **30 minutes of placing an order**, but only while the order status is `pending`.

A cancellation cannot be guaranteed. Once the status changes to `processing`, `shipped`, `delivered`, or another later state, the order cannot be cancelled through the normal cancellation process.

retrieved.heading: Address changes
retrieved.text:
An address correction may be requested within 30 minutes while an order is still pending. A human support specialist must complete the change.

After an order enters processing, Aster & Row cannot guarantee an address change. After shipment, the customer may contact the carrier, but carrier changes are outside Aster & Row’s control.

retrieved.heading: Product or quantity changes
retrieved.text: Items and quantities cannot be edited after checkout. When cancellation is still possible, the customer may request cancellation and place a new order.

retrieved.heading: Agent limitations
retrieved.text: The support agent may check the current order status and explain the policy. It must not claim that an order was cancelled or changed unless a supported action confirms completion.

retrieved.heading: What counts as final sale
retrieved.text:
An item is final sale only when the product page, cart, or order confirmation clearly labels it **FINAL SALE**. A discount or promotional code does not automatically make an item final sale.

Gift cards are always final sale.

retrieved.heading: Change-of-mind returns
retrieved.text: Final-sale items cannot be returned or exchanged because of fit, color preference, duplicate purchase, or another change of mind.

retrieved.heading: Damaged or incorrect items
retrieved.text: The final-sale restriction does not remove a customer’s right to report an item that arrived damaged, defective, or different from what was ordered. Those cases follow the Damaged or Wrong Items Policy.

retrieved.heading: Bundles
retrieved.text: A promotional bundle must be returned as a complete bundle unless a component arrived damaged or incorrect. A missing component may reduce or prevent the refund.

retrieved.heading: Processing time
retrieved.text: Most orders require **1–2 business days** for processing before they are dispatched. Business days exclude weekends and United States federal holidays.

retrieved.heading: Delivery estimates after dispatch
retrieved.text:
- Contiguous United States: **3–5 business days**.
- Alaska and Hawaii: **5–8 business days**.
- PO boxes: **5–9 business days**.

These are estimates rather than guaranteed delivery dates.

retrieved.heading: Shipping charges
retrieved.text:
Standard shipping is free for eligible United States orders of **$75 or more after discounts and before tax**. TrailPlus members receive free standard domestic shipping without a minimum order value.

Expedited shipping charges are shown at checkout and are not refundable unless Aster & Row shipped the wrong item or the shipment was damaged in transit.

retrieved.heading: Delivery problems
retrieved.text: A shipment marked delivered but not received should be reported to support. The agent may explain the policy but must not claim that a carrier investigation has been opened unless the application actually supports that action.

final_response:
Our return policy is the same as the one listed in the current returns policy guide.  

* **Return window** – Customers on the standard plan can request a return within **30 calendar days of delivery**. TrailPlus members who had an active membership when the order was placed get a longer window of **45 calendar days from delivery** (the longer window does not extend if the membership begins later).  
* **Item condition** – Returned items must be unused, unwashed, and in resalable condition. All original tags, accessories, and packaging supplied with the item must be included.  
* **Return shipping & refund** – A standard domestic return incurs a **$6.95 return‑shipping fee**, which is waived if the wrong item was sent or the item arrived damaged. Refunds are issued to the original payment method after inspection and normally take **5–7 business days** to appear.  
* **Exclusions** – Final‑sale items (those marked “FINAL SALE” or gift cards) cannot be returned for a change of mind, although they may still be eligible for assistance if they arrive damaged or incorrect. Warranty claims are handled separately.  

If you’re a TrailPlus member, let us know the order number and the date the membership was active so we can apply the correct return window.

final_response:
Our return policy is designed to be simple and fair for most orders. Here’s how it works:

**Standard plan customers**  
- You can request a return within **30 calendar days of delivery**. (01-returns-policy-current.md — Standard return window)  
- The item must be unused, unwashed, and in resalable condition, with original tags, accessories, and packaging included. (01-returns-policy-current.md — Item condition)  
- A **$6.95 return‑shipping fee** is deducted from the refund for domestic returns, unless we sent the wrong item or it arrived damaged. (01-returns-policy-current.md — Return shipping and refunds)  
- After we inspect the returned item, refunds are issued to your original payment method and should appear in 5–7 business days. (01-returns-policy-current.md — Return shipping and refunds)  

**TrailPlus members**  
- If your TrailPlus membership was active when you placed the order, you have a **45‑calendar‑day return window** from delivery. (09-trailplus-membership.md — Return window)  
- All other conditions (item condition, return‑shipping fee, refund timeline) are the same as for standard plan customers.  

**What can’t be returned for a change of mind**  
- Items that are marked **FINAL SALE** and **gift cards** are not returnable. (03-final-sale-and-promotions.md — What counts as final sale)  
- Final‑sale items may still be returned if they arrived damaged, defective, or wrong, following our Damaged or Wrong Items policy. (03-final-sale-and-promotions.md — Damaged or incorrect items)  

**International (Canadian) orders**  
- We do not provide prepaid return labels for ordinary Canadian change‑of‑mind returns; you’ll need to cover the return postage. (06-international‑shipping.md — Canadian returns)  
- If an item is wrong or damaged, we’ll provide a resolution without charging the usual return fee.  
- Direct exchanges are not offered for Canadian orders; you can return the item and place a new order instead.  

If you have an order ID or need help starting a return, let me know and I can walk you through the steps.

retrieved.heading: What counts as final sale
retrieved.text:
An item is final sale only when the product page, cart, or order confirmation clearly labels it **FINAL SALE**. A discount or promotional code does not automatically make an item final sale.

Gift cards are always final sale.

retrieved.heading: Change-of-mind returns
retrieved.text: Final-sale items cannot be returned or exchanged because of fit, color preference, duplicate purchase, or another change of mind.

retrieved.heading: Damaged or incorrect items
retrieved.text: The final-sale restriction does not remove a customer’s right to report an item that arrived damaged, defective, or different from what was ordered. Those cases follow the Damaged or Wrong Items Policy.

retrieved.heading: Bundles
retrieved.text: A promotional bundle must be returned as a complete bundle unless a component arrived damaged or incorrect. A missing component may reduce or prevent the refund.

retrieved.heading: Standard return window
retrieved.text:
Customers on the standard plan may request a return within **30 calendar days of delivery**.

TrailPlus members receive a different return window. See the TrailPlus Membership Policy. The membership must have been active when the order was placed.

retrieved.heading: Item condition
retrieved.text:
A returned item must be unused, unwashed, and in resalable condition. Original tags, accessories, and packaging must be included when they were supplied with the item.

Trying an item indoors for fit does not by itself make it ineligible. Visible wear, odors, stains, alterations, or missing components may cause the return to be rejected.

retrieved.heading: Return shipping and refunds
retrieved.text:
A **$6.95 return shipping fee** is deducted from the refund for standard domestic returns. The fee is waived when Aster & Row sent the wrong item or the item arrived damaged.

Refunds are issued to the original payment method after the return is inspected. Customers should allow **5–7 business days after inspection** for the refund to appear.

Original outbound shipping charges are not refundable unless the order was incorrect or damaged on arrival.

retrieved.heading: Exclusions and exceptions
retrieved.text:
Final-sale items and gift cards are not returnable for a change of mind. Damaged or incorrect final-sale items may still qualify for assistance under the Damaged or Wrong Items Policy.

Warranty claims are handled separately from ordinary returns.

retrieved.heading: Reporting window
retrieved.text:
Customers should report an item that arrived damaged, visibly defective, or different from what was ordered within **7 calendar days of delivery**.

The customer should provide the order ID, a short description, and clear photographs of the item and packaging when reasonably possible.

retrieved.heading: Available resolutions
retrieved.text:
After review, Aster & Row may offer a replacement, refund, or another appropriate resolution. Availability of a replacement depends on stock.

A return shipping fee is not charged when Aster & Row confirms that the item arrived damaged or that the wrong item was sent.

retrieved.heading: Final-sale items
retrieved.text: Final-sale items are still eligible for review when they arrive damaged, defective, or incorrect. Final sale only prevents change-of-mind returns.

retrieved.heading: Reports after seven days
retrieved.text:
A manufacturing defect reported after the seven-day arrival window may be considered under the Warranty Policy. Normal wear, accidental damage, and misuse are not arrival defects.

The support agent must not promise that a refund or replacement has been approved before a human review is completed.

retrieved.heading: Warranty periods
retrieved.text:
- Aster & Row bags and backpacks: **2 years from the purchase date**.
- Drinkware: **1 year from the purchase date**.
- Packing cubes and other travel accessories: **1 year from the purchase date**.

Aster & Row does not offer a lifetime warranty.

retrieved.heading: What is covered
retrieved.text: The limited warranty covers manufacturing defects in materials or workmanship under normal use. Examples may include a seam that separates without misuse or a zipper mechanism that fails because of a manufacturing defect.

retrieved.heading: What is not covered
retrieved.text: The warranty does not cover ordinary wear, cosmetic changes, accidental damage, airline or carrier damage, improper cleaning, modification, neglect, or misuse.

retrieved.heading: Final-sale products
retrieved.text: A product being marked final sale does not remove the limited warranty for a qualifying manufacturing defect.

retrieved.heading: Review process
retrieved.text: Warranty claims require proof of purchase and may require photographs. A human support specialist reviews eligibility. The agent may explain the policy and collect information, but it must not promise approval.

A returned item must be unused, unwashed, and in resalable condition. Original tags, accessories, and packaging must be included when they were supplied with the item.

Trying an item indoors for fit does not by itself make it ineligible. Visible wear, odors, stains, alterations, or missing components may cause the return to be rejected.

retrieved.heading: Return shipping and refunds
retrieved.text:
A **$6.95 return shipping fee** is deducted from the refund for standard domestic returns. The fee is waived when Aster & Row sent the wrong item or the item arrived damaged.

Refunds are issued to the original payment method after the return is inspected. Customers should allow **5–7 business days after inspection** for the refund to appear.

Original outbound shipping charges are not refundable unless the order was incorrect or damaged on arrival.

retrieved.heading: Exclusions and exceptions
retrieved.text:
Final-sale items and gift cards are not returnable for a change of mind. Damaged or incorrect final-sale items may still qualify for assistance under the Damaged or Wrong Items Policy.

Warranty claims are handled separately from ordinary returns.

retrieved.heading: Reporting window
retrieved.text:
Customers should report an item that arrived damaged, visibly defective, or different from what was ordered within **7 calendar days of delivery**.

The customer should provide the order ID, a short description, and clear photographs of the item and packaging when reasonably possible.

retrieved.heading: Available resolutions
retrieved.text:

I’m sorry to hear about the broken zipper. Even though the bag was marked **final‑sale**, that status does not remove your rights to a warranty or a damaged‑item claim.

* The limited warranty covers manufacturing defects such as a zipper that fails because of a defect in materials or workmanship (07‑warranty.md — What is covered).  
* A product being marked final‑sale does **not** remove the limited warranty for a qualifying defect (07‑warranty.md — Final‑sale products).  
* Final‑sale items are still eligible for review when they arrive damaged, defective, or incorrect (04‑damaged-or-wrong-items.md — Final‑sale items).  
* You should report the issue within **7 calendar days of delivery** (04‑damaged-or-wrong-items.md — Reporting window), which you’re still within.

To move forward, you’ll need to:

1. Gather your proof of purchase (order confirmation email).  
2. Take clear photos of the broken zipper and the packaging.  
3. Contact a support specialist (or reply with your order ID) so they can open a warranty/damaged‑item claim and advise on the next steps (e.g., replacement or repair).

I can’t process the claim for you, but a human support representative can complete it once you provide the details above.

**What you can do**

1. Gather your proof of purchase and clear photos of the broken zipper.
